'''Yosev Seville''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who accepted a contract to eliminate the [[winged xendrite]] infestation over [[Jacelle (Sirdar)|Jacelle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sirdar]].<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy" />
